overall_reason: The data copy is specific and honest (recurring-only note, refresh footnote, one promoted hero metric), but the skin is untouched Tailwind gray/blue-600 on Inter and the top-of-page and section sublines talk about the demo instead of the user's data.

findings.where: topbar subline under h1 'Analytics', and Settings section lede, 1440px and 375px
findings.evidence: Subline reads "Last 30 days · one shared theme · light + dark"; Settings lede reads "Same theme, same primitives, second page." Both describe the demo's construction to a developer, not anything a user of this analytics screen needs. Failed T-FRESH-READER: these are the two lines a fresh reader flags as fitting any design-system sample.
findings.before: "Last 30 days · one shared theme · light + dark" / "Same theme, same primitives, second page."
findings.after: "Last 30 days, to 09:00 UTC today" under Analytics; drop the Settings lede or replace with what the settings govern, e.g. "Name shown on exported reports" [DATA NEEDED: what the display name is used for]
findings.why: Self-reference is chat/demo residue; it tells the reader they are looking at a template, which is the opposite of made-for-this-client.

findings.evidence: Every surface and text token is a stock Tailwind swatch (#111827, #4b5563, #e5e7eb, #6b7280, #f9fafb) with blue-600 #2563eb as the only action colour and Inter as the only family. Failed T-DEFAULT-AGENT: 'analytics dashboard with light/dark theme' in any agent yields this exact palette and face. The sweep flagged the swatches; the judgment here is that nothing in the skin was chosen.
findings.after: Derive the action colour and greys from the product's own brand [DATA NEEDED: brand colour and display face]; keep the token structure, which is good, and change only the values
findings.why: The token architecture is deliberate but the values are the framework default, so the product has no visual identity of its own (SLP-187 tech-blue, SLP-119 product-chrome sameness).

findings.evidence: Churn 1.8% shows a red down-arrow "2%" (class .down, --color-feedback-error-icon). A fall in churn is good news, yet it is coloured as the error state; the colour is tied to arrow direction, not to whether the change is good.
findings.after: Map colour to sentiment, not direction: give the delta a data-sentiment="good|bad" and render churn down in the success colour; label it "down 0.04 pts" or "down 2% (better)"
findings.why: A KPI kit that colours by sign alone is the default-agent pattern; it reverses the meaning for inverse metrics like churn (DVZ-103: a stat tile needs a worded qualifier).

findings.evidence: T-STOCK-ORDER: title + action buttons, KPI hero, three equal stat cards (repeat(3,1fr)), settings card, footnote. The three-up stat row (Active users / Churn / NPS) with identical card, radius and shadow is the KPI-wall pattern, partly redeemed by the full-width revenue hero with its explanatory note. Only 2 stock sections, so the skeleton itself does not cap the read.
findings.before: Three equal cards: Active users 3,910 / Churn 1.8% / NPS 62
findings.after: Give each secondary metric its context the way Revenue has one (e.g. a one-line definition or the period's absolute change), or set them as a compact inline row rather than three identical cards
findings.why: Equal cards with a number and a percent read as filler metrics; the revenue card shows the page can do better.

findings.evidence: The input value "Plug" renders in Arial (computed fontFamily: Arial) while every other element is Inter; form controls do not inherit the font.
findings.after: input, button, select, textarea { font: inherit; }
findings.why: A mismatched face in the one text field is an unfinished-template tell.

findings.evidence: Display name is pre-filled with "Plug", a placeholder-like value that does not correspond to any user or account shown elsewhere.
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: the signed-in user's real display name], or leave empty with a format placeholder
findings.why: Leftover sample data at ship reads as residue.

strengths: Revenue card note "Recurring revenue only. One-off invoices are counted on the billing page, not here." is specific and honest; keep it.
Footer "Figures refresh hourly. Last run 09:00 UTC, from the analytics warehouse." sources the numbers, which answers the INT-007 stat-band concern in spirit.
One metric is promoted to a full-width hero with a note column instead of four equal tiles; the hierarchy is a decision.
Destructive action has a typed-confirmation dialog ("Type DELETE to confirm").
not_investigated: dark theme render: only the light theme was captured
brand: no contract or brand colours supplied, so the Tailwind palette cannot be checked against a brief
